nodes.title: Growth rate of a finitely generated group

nodes.summary: A group $G$ has exponential growth when it is finitely generated and every finite generating family $P$ of $G$ has growth rate $\omega(G, P) > 1$.
nodes.title: Groups of exponential growth

nodes.summary: A group $G$ is a branch group (Kourovka 15.12) if there are a sequence $m$ of natural numbers with $m(i) \ge 2$ for every $i$ and an action $\rho$ of $G$ by permutations of the vertices of the spherically homogeneous rooted tree with branching sequence $m$ such that: $\rho$ is faithful; each $\rho(g)$ is a tree automorphism, that is, for all vertices $v$ and $w$, $v$ is a prefix of $w$ if and only if $\rho(g)(v)$…
nodes.title: Branch groups (Kourovka 15.14 version)

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a group acting by permutations $\rho$ on the vertices of the rooted tree with branching sequence $m$, and let $n$ be a natural number. The $n$-th rigid level stabilizer of $\rho$ is the subgroup of $G$ generated by the rigid vertex stabilizers of all vertices at level $n$, the words of length $n$.
nodes.title: Rigid level stabilizers (Kourovka 15.14 version)

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a group acting by permutations $\rho$ on the vertices of the rooted tree with branching sequence $m$, and let $v$ be a vertex. The rigid vertex stabilizer of $v$ is the set of elements $g \in G$ whose support lies in the subtree rooted at $v$: $\rho(g)$ fixes every vertex $w$ of which $v$ is not a prefix.
nodes.title: Rigid vertex stabilizers (Kourovka 15.14 version)

nodes.summary: For a sequence $m$ of natural numbers, the vertices of the spherically homogeneous rooted tree with branching sequence $m$ are the finite words $l_0 l_1 \cdots l_{k-1}$ of natural numbers with $l_i < m(i)$ for every $i < k$. The length of a word is its level and its prefixes are its ancestors.
nodes.title: Vertices of a spherically homogeneous rooted tree (Kourovka 15.14 version)
